question: रोटी (Roti) किस चीज़ से बनती (Made) है? 🫓
explanation: Super star! रोटी (Roti) is made by mixing आटा (Flour) and water! 🌟
hint: It is a soft white or brown powder.

question: आटा (Flour) में क्या मिलाया (Mixed) जाता है? 🥣
explanation: Awesome! We pour पानी (Water) into the flour to make dough! 💧
hint: It comes from the tap and has no color.

question: हम आटा (Flour) और पानी (Water) किससे मिलाते (Mix) हैं? 🤲
explanation: Great job! We use our clean हाथ (Hands) to mix the dough! ✨
hint: You have ten fingers on them.

question: पानी मिलने पर गूँथा आटा (Dough) कैसा हो जाता है? ☁️
explanation: Yay! The dough becomes very मुलायम (Soft) and squishy! ☁️
hint: It feels like a sponge.

question: गूँथे हुए आटे (Dough) से हम क्या बनाते हैं? ⚾
explanation: Brilliant! We roll small pieces into a लोई (Dough ball)! ⚾
hint: It looks like a small round ball.

question: लोई (Dough ball) का आकार (Shape) कैसा होता है? 🔵
explanation: Perfect! The dough ball is perfectly गोल (Round)! ⚽
hint: It looks like a small ball or a marble.

question: रोटी (Roti) बेलने के लिए किस औज़ार (Tool) का उपयोग होता है? 🥖
explanation: Super! We use a बेलन (Rolling pin) to flatten the roti! 🥖
hint: It is a long wooden stick.

question: रोटी (Roti) को किस पर रखकर बेला (Rolled) जाता है? 🪵
explanation: Awesome! The round wooden board is called a चकला (Rolling board)! 🪵
hint: It is a flat, round wooden base.

question: बेलन (Rolling pin) देखने में कैसा होता है? 📏
explanation: Great! A rolling pin is लंबा (Long) and smooth! 📏
hint: It is not short.

question: पूरी तरह से बेली गई रोटी (Roti) कैसी दिखती है? 🌕
explanation: Yay! A beautiful roti is always गोल (Round)! ☀️
hint: It looks like the full moon.

question: बेलने के बाद रोटी (Roti) कैसी हो जाती है? 📄
explanation: Super star! Rolling makes the dough very पतली (Thin)! 📄
hint: It becomes flat like a paper.

question: रोटी (Roti) पकाने के लिए किस बर्तन (Utensil) का इस्तेमाल होता है? 🍳
explanation: Fantastic! We put the raw roti on a hot तवा (Pan)! 🍳
hint: It is flat and made of iron.

question: गैस (Gas) पर रखा तवा (Pan) कैसा होता है? 🔥
explanation: Watch out! The pan becomes very गरम (Hot) to cook the food! ♨️
hint: It can burn you if you touch it.

question: तवे (Pan) को गरम (Hot) करने के लिए क्या चाहिए? ♨️
explanation: Awesome! We need आग (Fire/Gas) to heat the pan! 🔥
hint: It gives out heat and light.

question: रोटी (Roti) तवे (Pan) पर क्या करती है? 🎈
explanation: Yay! When Roti is cooked, it फूलती है (Puffs up) beautifully! 🫓
hint: It gets filled with air.

question: फूली हुई रोटी (Puffed roti) किसके जैसी दिखती है? 🎈
explanation: Super! A hot puffed roti looks just like a round गुब्बारा (Balloon)! 🎈
hint: It is something you blow air into at parties.

question: गरम रोटी (Roti) को पलटने (Flip) के लिए क्या इस्तेमाल होता है? 🥢
explanation: Great! We safely use a चिमटा (Tongs) to hold and flip the hot roti! 🥢
hint: It is made of steel and pinches the roti.

question: चिमटा (Tongs) हमें किससे बचाता (Saves) है? 🔥
explanation: Brilliant! Tongs keep our hands away from the fire to save us from जलने (Burning)! 🔥
hint: It stops our skin from getting hurt by heat.

question: पकी हुई रोटी (Cooked roti) पर कैसे निशान (Marks) आते हैं? 🟤
explanation: Perfect! A well-cooked roti gets beautiful भूरे (Brown) spots! 🫓
hint: The color of chocolate.

question: फूली हुई रोटी (Puffed roti) के अंदर क्या भरा होता है? 💨
explanation: Yay! The heat creates गरम भाप (Hot Steam) inside the roti! ♨️
hint: It is hot air made from water.

question: गरमा-गरम रोटी (Roti) तवे (Pan) से कौन उतारता है? 👩‍🍳
explanation: Awesome! Our loving माँ (Mother) or adults safely cook for us! ❤️
hint: She cooks delicious food for the family.

question: रोटी (Roti) को गरम रखने के लिए किसमें रखते हैं? 🧺
explanation: Super star! A हॉटपॉट (Casserole) or basket keeps the roti soft and warm! 🧺
hint: It is an insulated box with a lid.

question: पकती हुई रोटी (Cooking roti) से कैसी महक (Smell) आती है? 😋
explanation: Fantastic! Fresh food gives a yummy सुगंध (Good smell)! 😍
hint: It makes your mouth water.

question: रोटी (Roti) पर स्वाद (Taste) के लिए क्या लगाते हैं? 🧈
explanation: Yummy! Spreading घी (Ghee) or butter makes it extra soft! 😋
hint: It is yellow and melts on hot food.

question: घी (Ghee) लगाने से रोटी (Roti) कैसी हो जाती है? 😍
explanation: Yay! Ghee makes everything very स्वादिष्ट (Tasty)! 🧈
hint: You enjoy eating it a lot.

question: रोटी (Roti) को हम किसके साथ खाते (Eat) हैं? 🥘
explanation: Brilliant! Eating Roti with सब्ज़ी (Vegetables) or Dal is very healthy! 🍲
hint: It is cooked with potatoes, peas, or spinach.

question: रोटी (Roti) को खाने (Eat) के लिए मुँह (Mouth) से क्या करते हैं? 👄
explanation: Perfect! We must slowly चबाते (Chew) our food with our teeth! 😁
hint: You use your teeth to do this.

question: रोटी (Roti) चबाते (Chewing) समय कैसी आवाज़ (Sound) आती है? 🎵
explanation: Super! Eating makes a soft चप-चप (Chap-chap) sound in our mouth! 😋
hint: It is the sound of chewing.

question: रोटी (Roti) हमें कैसी खानी (Eat) चाहिए? ♨️
explanation: Great job! Fresh and गरम (Warm) roti is the best! 🫓
hint: Not cold, not freezing.

question: रोटी (Roti) खाने से हमें क्या मिलती है? 💪
explanation: Awesome! Healthy food gives us ताकत (Energy) to play all day! 💪
hint: It makes you strong to run fast.

question: रोटी (Roti) खाने और बनाने से पहले क्या धोना (Wash) चाहिए? 🧼
explanation: Super star! Always wash your हाथ (Hands) to clean away germs! 🫧
hint: You use soap on them.

question: रोटी (Roti) को परोसने (Serving) के लिए किस बर्तन का उपयोग होता है? 🍽️
explanation: Fantastic! We keep our lovely food in a round थाली (Plate)! 🍛
hint: It is flat and round, you eat your food from it.

question: हम रोटी (Roti) क्यों खाते (Eat) हैं? 🥺
explanation: Yay! We eat food when we feel भूख (Hunger) in our tummy! 😋
hint: When your stomach is empty.

question: रोटी (Roti) खाने के बाद हमें क्या पीना (Drink) चाहिए? 💧
explanation: Brilliant! Drinking पानी (Water) helps us digest our yummy food! 💧
hint: It is clear and comes from a bottle or tap.

question: रोटी (Roti) किसके साथ बैठकर खानी चाहिए? 👨‍👩‍👧
explanation: Perfect! Enjoying meals with your परिवार (Family) is the best feeling! 🥰
hint: Your mother, father, and siblings.

question: जब हम अच्छे से रोटी (Roti) खा लेते हैं, तो पेट (Stomach) कैसा हो जाता है? 😊
explanation: Super! Our tummy feels happy and भरा हुआ (Full)! 😋
hint: You don't feel hungry anymore.

question: बची हुई (Leftover) ताज़ी रोटी हम किसे खिला सकते हैं? 🐄
explanation: Awesome! Sharing with animals like a गाय (Cow/Dog) is a very good habit! 🐄
hint: A friendly animal that gives milk.

question: रोटी (Roti) बनाने वाला आटा (Flour) किस अनाज से बनता है? 🌾
explanation: Great job! Wheat grains are ground to make गेहूँ (Wheat) flour! 🌾
hint: It grows in golden fields.

question: गुड़ (Jaggery) के साथ खाने पर रोटी (Roti) कैसी लगती है? 🤤
explanation: Yay! Jaggery makes everything taste very मीठी (Sweet) and lovely! 🤤
hint: It tastes like sugar or candy.

question: जब रोटी तवे पर फूलती (Puffs up) है, तो आपको कैसा लगता है? 😁
explanation: Super star! Watching it puff up like magic makes us very खुश (Happy)! 🌟
hint: You smile broadly.

question: रोटी (Roti) को चकले (Board) पर चिपकने से रोकने के लिए क्या लगाते हैं? 🌾
explanation: Fantastic! A little सूखा आटा (Dry flour) called Palthan stops the stickiness! ✨
hint: It is flour without water.

question: आसमान (Sky) में रोटी (Roti) के आकार (Shape) का क्या है? ☀️
explanation: Brilliant! The bright सूरज (Sun) is round just like a perfect Roti! 🌞
hint: It shines during the day.

question: हाथ (Hand) से रोटी (Roti) का टुकड़ा लेने के लिए क्या करते हैं? 🤏
explanation: Perfect! We gently तोड़ते (Break) small pieces with our fingers to eat! 🙌
hint: You pull a small piece away from the whole.

question: माँ (Mother) के साथ रोटी (Roti) बनाना कैसा काम है? 🥰
explanation: Awesome! Helping in the kitchen is a very मज़ेदार (Fun) activity! 🧑‍🍳
hint: You enjoy doing it.

question: रसोई (Kitchen) में आटा (Flour) किसमें रखा जाता है? 📦
explanation: Super! We store flour safely in a clean डिब्बे (Container)! 📦
hint: It is a box with a tight lid.

question: आटा (Flour) गूँथने के लिए किस बड़े बर्तन का उपयोग होता है? 🥣
explanation: Great! A big परात (Large Plate) gives space to mix the dough nicely! 🙌
hint: It is a very big metal plate with high edges.

question: गरम तवे (Hot pan) पर रोटी डालने से कैसी आवाज़ (Sound) आती है? 🎶
explanation: Yay! The hot pan makes a nice छन (Chhan) sizzling sound! 🔥
hint: It is a sizzling sound.

question: रोटी (Roti) खाकर बच्चे कैसे बन जाते हैं? 🦸‍♂️
explanation: Super star! Good food makes our muscles very ताकतवर (Strong)! 🦸‍♀️
hint: You become like a superhero.

question: हम रोटी (Roti) किस समय खाते हैं? ⏰
explanation: Brilliant! We sit and eat properly during खाने के समय (Mealtime)! 🍽️
hint: Breakfast, Lunch, or Dinner.

question: रात (Night) में आसमान की कौन सी चीज़ गोल रोटी (Round Roti) जैसी दिखती है? 🌕
explanation: Fantastic! The bright full चाँद (Moon) is completely round! 🌙
hint: It shines white at night.
